finding_dispositions.evidence: Malformed lexical units are charged before rejection; registry work precedes its charges; result dictionaries precede result charges.
No successful annotation propagation regression found.
Predicate registry remains token-constructed, exact-built-in-only, digest-bound, immutable, and capability-free.
Error rule registry remains bound to exact rule/code/phase triples.
Public ClosedSchemaRegistry construction permits forged schemas and digests to pass migration's isinstance check.
Budget corpus remains eight fixed production trace kinds times five budgets and omits required event families and migration registry failure modes.
Direct production constructors retain caller-owned nested aliases.

findings.claim: Production emitters violate lexical occurrence, registry ordering, work-before-charge, and result construction sequencing.
findings.evidence: b'???', b'trux', and b'01' emit parse.token before rejection; registry parse/profile/freeze work precedes registry.resource; result mappings are allocated before result charges.
findings.required_change: Validate lexical units before token emission; make registry charges precede work with incremental location limits; use charged result construction and add counterexamples.

findings.claim: Migration's closed schema registry can be forged.
findings.evidence: A directly constructed registry with True schemas and false digests migrates successfully.
findings.required_change: Use factory/token-only registry construction and exact pinned registry identity/digest checks with forged/missing/tampered counterexamples.

findings.claim: Budget and migration corpus is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Forty budget vectors cover eight templates and omit multiple production events and migration failure modes.
findings.required_change: Add independent production traces and exact cutoffs for all event families plus missing/forged/zero/ambiguous migration cases.

findings.claim: Public constructors permit mutable aliases after digest verification.
findings.evidence: Direct schema/profile/compatibility construction can change behavior without changing digests.
findings.required_change: Make constructors factory-only or validate and deep-freeze every path; add mutation tests.
